summary: New type role --ui-text-footnote (Tailwind: text-footnote), issue #59. It is 12px fixed, 400, leading 1.35, tracking −0.02em: quiet supporting text at the size floor, set next to a 600 label or figure (a scale, a predicate, a comparison, a count). It brings the -weight, -leading and -tracking companions every role carries. It replaces the 13 declared label-sm-at-400 exceptions (ADR 0020, amendment of 2026-11-23). cn() merges it as a font-size.

migration.manual: A brand theme regenerated with resolveThemePair gets the role automatically; a hand-written theme must add the four tokens. A consumer writing `text-label-sm font-regular` for supporting text can use `text-footnote` instead.
